spec_metadata.title: LRS Firmware Complete Reverse Specification
spec_metadata.target_consumer: AI coding agents (Codex-class) for clean-room reimplementation
notes: This specification is derived from current code and repository docs.
Hardware assumptions are strict for LRS board version v1.2.
When this spec marks an item as inferred, it is a best-fit interpretation and should be surfaced during implementation review.

product_context.high_level_purpose: Extend a dry-contact control signal over LoRa between paired ESP8266 nodes with secure packet exchange, web configuration, optional MQTT bridge, and OTA support.

node_roles.tx: Reads local dry-contact input, sends LoRa state, waits for ACK, mirrors ACK-confirmed remote relay state with delay.
node_roles.rx: Receives LoRa state packets, drives relay output, sends ACK for Change/Heartbeat packets, applies MQTT LoRa commands without ACK.

critical_priorities_ranked.name: Uninterrupted LoRa relay control
critical_priorities_ranked.requirement: LoRa relay control path shall remain responsive and deterministic even during WiFi reconnects, MQTT outages/reconnect attempts, web requests, OTA handling, and sensor reads.

critical_priorities_ranked.name: Safe fail behavior
critical_priorities_ranked.requirement: On ACK timeout or invalid control conditions, fail to known safe relay state according to TX/RX semantics.

critical_priorities_ranked.name: Remote manageability
critical_priorities_ranked.requirement: WiFi, web UI, MQTT, and OTA are secondary services and must never degrade Priority #1 behavior.

notes: GPIO0 and GPIO2 are boot-sensitive strap-linked pins.
DS18B20 pin is forced to GPIO0 in runtime settings handling.

build_metadata_injection.dirty_tree_rule: If git tree is dirty, build_id becomes deterministic fingerprint of patch set and untracked blob hashes.

release_flash.password_derivation: Must match firmware deriveShortPassword logic for AP/admin credential recovery.

admin_auth.factory_default: Derived deterministic short password from chip id

radio_security.default_passphrase_policy: POST /api/settings rejects default passphrase unless allow_default_deployment_key=true
radio_security.runtime_guardrail: LoRa TX/RX disabled when fleet_passphrase equals default

main_tick_order: Inject local temp into state machine
runtime_architecture.control_loop_priority_rule: LoRa state machine tick must execute before MQTT tick to prevent broker latency from degrading relay control path.
rtos_style_scheduling_requirements: Treat LoRa receive/transmit + state transitions as highest-priority task class.
All non-control tasks (WiFi management, MQTT, web server, OTA, sensor polling) must run cooperatively and be bounded-time.
No blocking wait >50ms is permitted in normal loop execution outside explicit maintenance/test endpoints.
If long operations are unavoidable, they must be chunked with yields and must not postpone control tick execution beyond one loop period budget.

state_transitions: If STA credentials exist, begin connect.
On success: mark connected, log sta_connected, maybe disable AP.
On connect timeout: disconnect STA, keep AP fallback, log sta_connect_failed_fallback_ap.
On disconnect after prior connect: log sta_disconnected, re-enable AP, schedule reconnect.

ota.hostname: same normalized hostname logic as LAN

payload_12b_standard.b4: sensor_mask (bit0 digital present, bit1 temperature present)
payload_12b_standard.b5: sensor_digital0 (defaults to input if not provided)

payload_12b_custom_types.W: Wifi provisioning segmented transfer (start/data/commit) using custom payload byte semantics
payload_12b_custom_types.X: Factory reset command with keep-fleet-key option using custom payload byte semantics
payload_12b_custom_types.transport_note: Uses same encrypted 12-byte payload slot and packet framing via raw payload send path

mac_verification.input: mac_key(32) prepended + packet bytes excluding mac field

radio_runtime_behavior.enable_rule: disabled when passphrase is default; LoRa.sleep()
radio_runtime_behavior.enabled_mode: LoRa.receive() after send and after configuration
drop_conditions: source mismatch for configured peer relationship

wire_compatibility.upgrade_requirement: paired nodes must run the new 12-byte payload firmware

tx.input_transition_behavior: On debounced input change and input_control_paired_lora_enabled=true, send Change with relay=input and input=input.
tx.startup_sync_behavior: On boot/applyConfig when input_control_paired_lora_enabled=true, send one Change sync if no command pending.
tx.retry_behavior: If command pending and retry deadline reached, resend Change with last pending states.
tx.heartbeat_behavior: Every heartbeat_ms send Heartbeat. heartbeat relay field = input_state if input_control_paired_lora_enabled else relay_state.
tx.ack_timeout_behavior: If in wait_ack and elapsed >= ack_timeout_ms, force local relay OFF and enter timeout.
tx.ack_receive_behavior: On Ack from remote peer: schedule local relay apply after 500ms, clear pending retries, enter idle.

rx.relay_apply: Set relay_state and physical relay pin to received relay_state
rx.control_source_tracking: LoRa for Change/Heartbeat, Mqtt for Mqtt
rx.ack_behavior: Send Ack for Change and Heartbeat only; do not Ack Mqtt packets

replay_protection.accept_rule: counter must be strictly greater than last seen for that source

temperature_handling.local_encoding: round to nearest int Celsius, clamp [-127,126], encode int8; invalid -> 0xFF
temperature_handling.remote_capture: If temp_code != 0xFF then store int8 celsius and millis timestamp

relay_topic.behavior: Immediately set local relay via state machine mqttSetLocalRelay()

payload_json.addr: number (decimal) OR string (parsed as hex via strtoul base16)

control_topic.result: Send LoRa MessageType::Mqtt to provided addr

control_semantics.important_edge_case: If addr is string '40', it is interpreted as hex 0x40 (decimal 64).

local_ds18b20.detection: first OneWire address found; if none => not_detected

remote_temperature.display/state: stored in NodeStateMachine remote temp fields

429.error: Too many failed logins. Try again shortly.

GET /api/settings.response: Current editable config fields including credentials and MQTT settings

behavior: Enforce fleet key policy if posted
Trigger on_apply callback with networkChanged and otaAuthChanged flags
Restore configured STA credentials after test when test differs from persisted config

POST /api/mqtt/test.behavior: Attempt short MQTT connect and return ok/state

POST /api/ota.behavior: multipart OTA upload via Update API, restart on success

POST /api/reboot.behavior: set audit reboot reason to web_reboot, save config, restart

logging_and_diagnostics_contract.serial_mirror: Each log event is printed to Serial with structured fields.
readability_requirements_for_field_incid: Logs must be easy to correlate chronologically for "command missed / delayed relay" incidents.
Every control-path event should include event class, role, source/destination address, counter, and relay/input state snapshot.
Every potential blocker event should be explicit (WiFi reconnect attempt, MQTT reconnect attempt, web request burst, OTA in progress).
A single-line summary view must allow operators to identify whether control loop starvation occurred.
minimum_additional_events_for_next_imple: control_tick_overrun when loop delta exceeds configured budget

timing.control_loop: Must not block on MQTT/network operations in control-critical path
timing.hard_real_time_intent: RTOS-like cooperative determinism for LoRa control path on bare-metal loop architecture

reliability.ack_timeout_fail_safe: TX local relay forced OFF on ack timeout
reliability.starvation_protection_requirement: System shall detect and surface when control loop cadence degrades beyond budget.
reliability.watchdog_requirement_for_next_implementa: Enable and feed watchdog from control loop heartbeat so scheduler lockups trigger safe recovery.

recommended_order: Implement immutable config schema + persistence + deterministic derivations
Implement radio packet codec/crypto and deterministic vectors
Implement state machine with simulation tests
Implement app networking orchestration and OTA
must_match_behavior_exactly: API field names and key response semantics
allowed_internal_variance: UI implementation details if API and behavior remain equivalent
Internal logging implementation as long as exports and key event semantics are preserved

unit_tests: Given fixed passphrase, derived enc/mac keys are deterministic and correct.
Given packet fixture, MAC verification passes/fails correctly.
Counter replay protection drops duplicate or lower counters per source.
Address parser accepts decimal ints and hex strings and clamps invalid values.
Hostname normalization enforces allowed charset and max length.
Config guardrails clamp heartbeat/ack timeout/frequency and force sensor pin 0.
integration_tests: TX input change causes Change packet, RX relay update, RX Ack, TX relay update after ~500ms.
ACK timeout path forces TX relay OFF and sets timeout state.
Heartbeat emits at configured interval and RX Ack behavior matches spec.
Default deployment key disables radio send/receive.
MQTT relay topic toggles local relay only.
MQTT control topic on TX sends LoRa Mqtt packet and RX applies without Ack.
STA fallback keeps AP active when STA credentials fail.
AP can disable after stable STA when ap_always_on=false.
DS18B20 detect/read updates local temp and transmits remote temp metadata.
Under induced WiFi reconnect storms, LoRa control latency remains within control loop budget and no missed relay transitions occur.
Under MQTT broker outage and reconnect attempts, LoRa ACK/timeout behavior remains unchanged.
Under concurrent web polling at high rate, LoRa relay control remains deterministic.
api_contract_tests: Auth-required endpoints return 401 without valid session.
Login lockout triggers after 5 failed attempts and returns 429 during lock window.
POST /api/settings rejects short deployment key and default key unless explicit override.
GET /api/status includes expected keys and valid types.
OTA upload returns ok and device restarts on valid image.
field_validation_tests: Flash release script prints AP/admin credentials matching firmware-generated values.
ZA build uses 433 MHz default; US build uses 915 MHz default.
Factory endpoint reports hardware version v1.2 and batch 251101.
Incident replay test: reproduce temporary gate non-response scenario and confirm logs conclusively show whether control starvation, RF loss, or ACK timeout occurred.

inferred_items: Some UI text and tab labels are treated as non-normative except where tied to workflow constraints.
Factory 'role defaults to TX' is taken from tooling/docs and current behavior, not a hard firmware lock.
No formal protocol version field currently exists; versioning guidance is procedural.
out_of_scope_for_v1_2_rebuild: Backward compatibility with legacy 4-byte payload firmware
